rows.meaning: to end; come to an end
rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice when something simply finishes or reaches its end.

example.english: The movie is scheduled to end at eight.

rows.note: Use this when someone deliberately ends an activity or when an event is being formally concluded.

example.english: We will end the meeting at five.
example.jyutping: wui5 ji5 dou3 ng5 dim2 zau6 git3 cuk1

rows.note: Use 尾 for the last part or physical endpoint of something, including the end of a place, period, or long object.

example.english: The seaside is at the end of the road.
example.jyutping: tiu4 lou6 haang4 dou3 mei5 zau6 hai6 hoi2 bin1

rows.note: Use 結束 for the cessation of an activity, effort, state, or motion.

example.english: The meeting finally came to an end.
example.jyutping: go3 wui6 ji5 zung1 jyu1 git3 cuk1 laa3

rows.note: Use 結果 when end means the result or outcome of events or actions.

example.english: In the end, the result is still your choice.
example.traditional: 最後嘅結果都係你自己揀。
example.jyutping: zeoi3 hau6 ge3 git3 gwo2 dou1 hai6 nei5 zi6 gei2 gaan2

rows.note: Use 死 as a noun for death, especially in possessive phrases such as 佢嘅死.

example.english: His father's death marked the end of the family's happiness.
example.traditional: 佢阿爸嘅死，標誌住呢個家庭快樂嘅終結。
example.jyutping: keoi5 aa3 baa4 ge3 sei2 biu1 zi3 zyu6 ni1 go3 gaa1 ting4 faai3 lok6 ge3 zung1 git3
